verses.waha-ilin-zakhiri-l-amwaji-murtakimi-c1-: wahāʾili zākhiri l-ʾamwāji murtakimi qaṭaʿtuhu qāṣidā lil-ḥilli wal-ḥarami
kammil ʾilahiyā yā raḥmānu ḥajjatanā wakhallaṣathā bijāhi sh-shāfiʿi l-ḥakami
ʿani r-riyāʾi waʿan ʿujbi waʿan kibari bal naqqiyan sayranā ʿan sāʾiri t-tuhami
ʾaʿūdhu billāhi ʾishrākī bihi ʾabadā wakuntu ʾaʿlamu jalla llāhu dhū l-qidami
mustaghfirā kulla mā lam ʾaku ʾaʿlamuhu faʾinnahu l-ghāfiru l-ʿāfī ʿani l-jurami
waʾinna maghfirata r-raḥmani ʾawsaʿu min dhanbī waraḥmatuhu ʾarjā mina l-khidami
ḥabasta ʿan khidmahi man kunta taḥbisuhu muṭliqa man shiʾita rabbī ghayra mujtarimi
wafiʿluka llāhu lam yasʾal bihi ʾaḥadu siwā ghabiyyi ghawiyyi mushriki fadimi
wal-manʿa maʿ khaybati l-ʾāmāli fīka falā tajmaʿ bifaḍlika yā dhā l-jūdi wal-karami
kam mujrimi ʾāsifi ʾawlayta maghfirata ʾidh ʾamma baytaka rabba l-ʾashhuri l-ḥurumi
bil-ḥilmi ʾanḥū libayti llāhi muzdaḥimā ʾakhyārahu l-hājirīna n-nawma fī ẓ-ẓulami
waḥuṭṭa wizrī wawizra l-wālidīna wawiz rā lil-mashīkhati wal-ʾaḥbābi wal-ḥashami
wakulli rājī duʿāʾī fī l-mawāqifi yā mawlayā yā rabbanā yā muʿṭiyā l-ʿiṣami
fal-qurabā lahum ḥaẓẓu kadhā l-buʿadā waʾanta ʾaʿlamu minnī qadra ḥaqqahimi
waman lahu ʿindanā ḥaqqu waman tabiʿū likulli mā jāʾahu l-mukhtāru fī l-qidami
fāstur ʿuyūbiyā fī d-dārayni yā thiqatī wala tukhayyab rajāʾī fārija l-himami
mawlāyā ṣalli ṣalāta ʿadda man dhakarū waʿadda man ghafalū rabbī mina l-ʾumami
ʾazkā ṣalāti waʾaʿlahā waʾaṭyabuhā ʿalā rasūlika khayri l-ʿurbi wal-ʿajami
wasallimanna salāmā fawqa dhī ʿadadā ʿalā muḥammadi l-mabʿūthi bil-ḥikami
wal-ʾāli waṣ-ṣaḥbi wal-ʾazwāji mā sajalat wurqu l-ḥamāmi ʿalā l-ʾaghṣāni bin-naghami
waṣalliyan ʿadada l-ʾashjāri bal ʿadada l-ʾamwāji war-ramli wal-ʾakhlāqi kullihimi
